title: Load Dishwasher - Kitchen A
description: Record yourself loading at least 5 different types of dishes (plates, bowls, cups, silverware) into a dishwasher from a countertop. Ensure the dishwasher door starts closed, is opened during the video, and closed at the end. Perform this action 10 times from slightly different angles.

title: Route Power Cables - Server Rack
description: Demonstrate routing 3 thick power cables (C13/C14) through a standard 1U cable management arm. Clip the cables securely. Perform this full action 5 times.

title: Uncap and Recap Medicine Vials
description: Pick up a standard plastic medicine vial, twist off the child-proof cap, place the cap on the table, pick it back up, and securely recap the vial. Perform this action 20 times.

title: Pouring Coffee
description:
1. put a mug on the table
2. hold the Jug with coffee in it
3. Pour it while keeping the hands, jug and mug all clearly visible
4 After pouring the coffee to the mug, place the Jug down on the table.
